title: RadioArchive: recorders
description: Each recorder's signals (R14): connected, deaf or down, quiet; its client's version and queue (R5, R6); the decode rate per system; calls rejected from a recorder and shortName not attached to a system (R12). Recorders are named as admins named them; no talkgroup or unit is named.

panels.title: Connected
panels.description: 1 while the recorder's client has its live connection open. Worry: 0 for more than 2 minutes (the "Recorder disconnected" alert).

panels.title: Signals tripped
panels.description: Each recorder's tripped signals: disconnected, deaf (trunk-recorder down, or a control channel lost) and quiet (where an admin set a threshold).

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: The version each recorder's client last connected with, and whether it's a minor version behind the server (R6). A client two behind is refused, and counted below.

panels.title: Decode rate per system
panels.description: Control-channel messages a second, per recorder and system, as trunk-recorder reports them. A healthy P25 control channel decodes about 40. Near 0 for an attached system: its control channel is lost (deaf).

panels.title: Client queue: oldest recording waiting
panels.description: How long the oldest recording in each client's queue has waited to upload (R5). Worry: over an hour (the "Client queue backed up" alert). Entries over QUEUE_MAX_AGE (24 h) are dropped.

panels.title: Calls rejected from unattached recorder systems
panels.description: Calls from a recorder and trunk-recorder shortName not attached to any system, over the retention period (R12). A rise: attach the pair on the Systems page, or stop trunk-recorder recording that system.

panels.title: Clients refused and out of date
panels.description: Recorder client connections and uploads refused for being more than one minor version behind, and connections from clients one behind (R6), in each 5 minutes. Recorder clients are upgraded by hand (R86).
